annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation must accept RSASSA-PSS signatures even when TLS 1.2 is negotiated, regardless of whether it advertised support for it.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation must accept RSASSA-PSS signatures even when TLS 1.2 is negotiated, but *only* if it advertised support for it.
annotation.justification: The phrase "MUST be prepared to accept" is incomplete. It doesn't specify whether the acceptance is conditional on the implementation having advertised support for RSASSA-PSS. This creates two reasonable interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the acceptance requirement applies unconditionally or is contingent on advertising support for RSASSA-PSS.
